```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

INPUT="/home/eval/data/orders.json"
CUSTOMERS_OUT="/home/eval/data/customers.jsonl"
TOP_SKU_OUT="/home/eval/data/top_sku.txt"

# 1. Summarise customers from paid orders
jq -c '
  map(select(.status == "paid"))
  | group_by(.customer)
  | map({
      customer: .[0].customer,
      orders: length,
      total: ([.[].items[]? | (.qty * .price)] | add // 0)
    })
  | sort_by([- .total, .customer])
  | .[]
' "$INPUT" > "$CUSTOMERS_OUT"

# 2. Find SKU with largest total quantity across paid orders
jq -r '
  map(select(.status == "paid"))
  | [.[].items[]?]
  | group_by(.sku)
  | map({ sku: .[0].sku, qty: (map(.qty) | add // 0) })
  | sort_by(- .qty)[0]
  | "\(.sku) \(.qty)"
' "$INPUT" > "$TOP_SKU_OUT"

exit 0
```
